_metadata.description: The audit conductor: profile-mode build, BAS perf-capture invocation, restore, and graceful headless skip.

requirements.title: Conduct the profile-mode capture pipeline
requirements.description: audit conducts profile-mode restart → verify the served bundle is the profile bundle → call BAS perf-capture (CDP trace + web-vitals) → restore the default build, behind restart/exec/BAS-client seams.

validation.notes: Fakes for restart/exec/BAS client assert the ordered pipeline and that the default build is always restored, even on capture failure.

requirements.title: Capture never fails for lack of instrumentation
requirements.description: Absent ⚛ component marks are a Tier 0 result, not an error; the audit records the achieved tier and proceeds. performance-health owns tier meaning; BAS stays agnostic.

validation.notes: A trace with zero ⚛ marks yields a Tier 0 result with no error; a trace with ⚛ marks yields Tier 1.

requirements.title: Graceful headless / no-UI skip
requirements.description: The audit pipeline skips cleanly (mirroring the Lighthouse silent-skip) when there is no UI, no browser, or a headless environment, returning a skipped result rather than a failure.

validation.notes: No-UI and no-browser conditions return a skipped result with a reason, not a finding-level failure.
